title: Expedition 33 Boss Order - Recommended Levels
description: Complete boss order for all 165 bosses in Expedition 33 with recommended levels, locations, and boss types organized by Act for optimal progression.

sections.title: Overview (165 Bosses Total)
sections.content:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 contains a total of 165 bosses including story-required bosses, optional overworld encounters, Chromatic variants, and Endless Tower fights. Most are optional and found either on The Continent's overworld or hidden at the ends of side passages within dungeons.

Understanding Boss Types

  • Required: Must be defeated to progress the main story
  • Optional: Entirely skippable but reward weapons, Pictos, or experience
  • Chromatic: Enhanced versions of regular enemies with boosted stats and rewards

DANGER Zones

When exploring, you'll encounter areas marked as "DANGER" — this means your party doesn't meet the recommended level. The game does not tell you what level is required, which is why this boss order guide exists. Fighting underleveled is possible but extremely punishing.

Recommended Approach

Follow the tables below in order. Fight story bosses as they appear, tackle optional bosses in your current level range between story dungeons, and save Chromatic bosses for when you're at or above their recommended level. Being 2-3 levels above recommendation makes fights comfortable without removing challenge.

Act 3 and postgame bosses range from Level 45 to 55+. The full postgame contains approximately 90+ additional optional encounters across previously locked areas, relationship-gated dungeons, and the Endless Tower.

Notable Postgame Bosses

  • Simon (Level 50): Located in Renoir's Drafts. Widely considered the hardest boss in the game — required for the "Peace At Last" trophy
  • Alicia (Level 48): Found in The Reacher, accessible only at Maelle relationship Level 5. Drops Lithum weapon
  • Chromatic Gold Chevaliere (Level 50): In the Crimson Forest. Drops Chevalam weapon for Gustave/Verso

sections.title: Endless Tower
sections.content:
The Endless Tower is Expedition 33's ultimate combat challenge — a multi-floor gauntlet available in Act 3 that pits you against increasingly powerful foes with limited recovery between fights.

Structure

  • Multiple floors of escalating difficulty
  • Each floor features a unique boss or enhanced enemy encounter
  • Limited healing between floors — resource management is critical
  • Unique rewards exclusive to Tower completion including Cleim (Lune's endgame weapon)

Preparation

  • Bring a diverse party that covers multiple elements
  • Lune as healer is almost mandatory for sustained runs
  • Stock up on Elixirs and revival items before entering
  • Level 45+ recommended for the first floors, Level 55+ for deeper floors

Key Tower Bosses

FloorBossNotable Reward
Mid-TowerEnhanced Chromatic variantsRare Pictos
Upper FloorsRemixed story bossesUpgrade materials
Final FloorClea UnleashedCleim (Lune weapon)

The Endless Tower does not need to be completed in one session — you can leave and return without losing progress, though defeated floors remain cleared.

sections.title: Tips for Optional Bosses
sections.content:
Optional bosses in Expedition 33 are significantly harder than story bosses of the same level. Here are strategies to handle them efficiently:

General Approach

  • Be at or above recommended level: Optional bosses assume optimal play. Being 2 levels above their recommendation provides comfortable margin.
  • Exploit elemental weaknesses: Every boss has at least one weakness. Switch Lune's weapon and skills to match.
  • Parry everything: Optional boss fights are long. The extra AP from consistent parrying is the difference between 10-turn fights and 20-turn ones.
  • Break when possible: Using Rockslide/Crustal Crush to Break bosses before their signature attacks prevents massive damage.

Chromatic Boss Tips

  • Chromatic variants use the same attack patterns as their base versions with higher damage and sometimes new moves
  • If you've fought the base version, you already know the parry timings
  • They often have elemental resistances — bring multiple damage types
  • Reward weapons from Chromatic bosses are consistently among the best in the game

Party Composition for Hard Fights

SlotRecommendedRole
1LuneHealer + Elemental DPS
2Maelle or VersoPrimary DPS
3Sciel or MonocoSecondary DPS / Support

For the absolute hardest fights (Simon, Clea Unleashed), consider building specifically for the encounter rather than using a general-purpose party.
